action_instruction: Counting the rows under Item / Price / Quantity / Total for Order #1001
intent: PRIMARY: Count the rows under the "Item / Price / Quantity / Total" header on the "Order #1001" page; role=table | HINTS: container=Order #1001 Delivered
rationale: The table shows one item row followed immediately by the Subtotal line.

action_instruction: Counting item rows in the order table
intent: the number of item data rows under the Item, Price, Quantity, and Total header in the order table

action_params.condition: There is exactly 1 row under the "Item / Price / Quantity / Total" header.
action_params.query: the number of item data rows under the Item, Price, Quantity, and Total header in the order table

action_instruction: Counting Notebook, Dot Grid text occurrences
intent: the number of text occurrences of Notebook, Dot Grid in the order page main content

action_params.condition: The text "Notebook, Dot Grid" appears exactly once on the whole page.
action_params.query: the number of text occurrences of Notebook, Dot Grid in the order page main content
action_params.code_js: Array.from(el(7).querySelectorAll('*')).filter(n => Array.from(n.childNodes).some(c => c.nodeType === 3 && c.nodeValue.includes('Notebook, Dot Grid'))).reduce((n,e) => n + Array.from(e.childNodes).filter(c => c.nodeType === 3).reduce((m,c) => m + (c.nodeValue.match(/Notebook, Dot Grid/g) || []).length, 0), 0)

action_instruction: Checking whether the Subtotal line follows the item row
intent: whether the Subtotal line immediately following the order item table is present

action_params.condition: The "Subtotal" line comes directly after that single row.
action_params.query: whether the Subtotal line immediately following the order item table is present
action_params.code_js: (() => { const next = el(12).nextElementSibling; return !!next && next.matches('dl') && next.firstElementChild === el(25) && el(25).textContent.trim() === 'Subtotal'; })()

assertion_tree.description: There is exactly 1 row, the text "Notebook, Dot Grid" appears exactly once on the whole page, and the "Subtotal" line comes directly after that single row.

sub_results.description: There is exactly 1 row under the "Item / Price / Quantity / Total" header.
The text "Notebook, Dot Grid" appears exactly once on the whole page.
The "Subtotal" line comes directly after that single row.

assertion_tree.verification: The row count, the occurrence count of "Notebook, Dot Grid" on the whole page, and the placement of the "Subtotal" line relative to the single row.
